messages:
mika: FYI new consignment landed: s3://redwood-ingest/consignments/zenith-320b/2026-03-19/partial

mika: manifest + top-level checksum pasted below, tagging for triage. please ack if you can take custody. :eyes:
```
manifest.json:
- model.bin (sha256: 6a1f...e3b2)
- tokenizer.json (sha256: d4c2...7f11)
- config.json (sha256: 9b8a...0c4f)
- provenance.json (MISSING)
```

lena: on it. can someone confirm tokenizer hash vs registry? last time we got a tokenizer mismatch that changed BOM behaviour. :warning:

owen: grabbing tokenizer now. quick check: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ingest/consignments/zenith-320b/2026-03-19/tokenizer.json /tmp/ && sha256sum /tmp/tokenizer.json`

ingest-bot: scan complete — objects scanned: 3, total size: 318GB, provenance tag: absent for tokenizer.json, kms-wrapped: false

owen: confirmed hash d4c2...7f11 != registry entry for zenith-320b-tokenizer (registry hash d4c2...1aa3). small diff, looks like extra metadata field added. sending diff: `git diff --no-index tokenizer.registry.json tokenizer.json`

rajesh: don't merge into onboarded registry yet. if tokenizer mapping changed we need token-stability evals + embedding sanity. I'll bump priority.

mika: understood. propose scope: (1) custody + provenance attach (2) tokenizer diff triage (3) quick tokenization-stability eval (50 prompts) (4) small quant smoke (4-bit) for perf baseline. owner: lena. priority: P1 for intake, P2 for registry promotion.

eva: for token-stability evals I can run the 50-prompt harness on dedicated-1 (ded-1). will run baseline vs current registry tokenization and collect mismatched tokenization rate + decoded-text diff. ETA 6h. :white_check_mark:

lena: taking custody. steps I'll run now:
```bash
# copy artifacts to secure staging bucket
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ingest/consignments/zenith-320b/ s3://redwood-staging/zenith-320b/ --recursive --acl bucket-owner-full-control
# compute checksums and attach provenance file
sha256sum s3://redwood-staging/zenith-320b/* > /tmp/zenith-320b.sha256
# attach provenance.json (template)
aws s3 cp provenance.template.json s3://redwood-staging/zenith-320b/provenance.json --metadata owner=lena,ingest_ts=2198765432
```

owen: heads-up — quant bench needs a small patch to runtime flags for long-seq perf. I can run the 4-bit smoke on ded-1 but might need 2 slots. suggest scheduled window 10:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow.

rajesh: also lock the model-version in temp registry with `state: quarantined` so other systems don't pick it up. I'll update the registry API: `POST /registry/models -d '{"name":"zenith-320b","version":"v0-landing","state":"quarantined"}'`

lena: done. temporary registry entry created with tag `quarantine:v0-landing`. provenance file added (with ingest metadata) but note: tokenizer provenance.source_url missing (we only have S3 path). adding note in provenance and opening ticket to request upstream supplier metadata.

mika: thanks. if token-stability fails we need to rollback to registry tokenizer and request supplier diff. if stability ok, then run quant smoke and embedding alignment check (cosine similarity on eval set).

eva: token-stability run complete: mismatch rate 3.7% on 50 prompts, most diffs are minor whitespace/metadata tokens except 2 prompts with decoding changes that affect instruction tokens. attaching summary: `mismatch_summary.csv` uploaded to thread.

owen: 3.7% is borderline. for embeddings I ran a quick 100-sample cosine check (old-tokenizer vs new-tokenizer tokenized->embed->mean) -> mean cosine 0.998, worst 0.92. the 0.92 case matches one of the decoding-changed prompts.

lena: next steps proposal: 1) ask supplier for tokenizer provenance and exact build step 2) attempt safe-normalization (drop metadata tokens) and re-run tokenization-stability 3) if re-run <1% mismatch, can promote to canary with heavy monitoring.

mika: agree. set up canary rollout policy: 5% traffic, latency/quality SLOs, auto-fallback to v0-registry-tokenizer on quality regression >1% or embed-sim drop >0.02. eva, can you own the canary monitors if we get to that?

eva: yes, will add dashboards and alerting (alert if mismatch_rate >1% OR mean_embed_cosine < 0.98).

rajesh: note on security: KMS wrapping required before we mark `kms-wrapped:true` in provenance. lena please coordinate with infra for HSM/KMS wrap.

lena: pinged infra@ (internal) for KMS wrap key; added action in ticket INGEST-4821.

mika: summary — custody assigned to lena, token diff triage in progress, eva ran initial stability and monitoring plan ready, owen will run quant smoke tomorrow in ded window. next sync in thread tomorrow morning. thanks all :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: ticket INGEST-4821 created by lena — provenance request / kms-wrap / supplier metadata.
